newsitem.title: USA: LA. regulator says Conoco fire out quickly.
newsitem.headline: LA. regulator says Conoco fire out quickly.

text.p: The fire Monday evening at Conoco's Lake Charles, Louisiana refinery was extinguished in about five minutes, according to a Louisiana environmental regulator.

"It was a very short duration flash fire. It was extinguished in a matter of five minutes," the official said, noting the fire was in the vapor recovery unit in the refinery's fluid catalytic cracking unit.
"I don't know if they shut it down," the official noted.
Officials at Conoco, a unit of DuPont Co, said refinery operations were not affected by the fire and that no units were shut down.
Earlier Tuesday, gasoline futures prices shot up on rumors that a unit was shut at the plant but later lost those gains.
-- Oliver Ludwig, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1620
